title: A finite type domain over a field has the dimension of each of its local rings at maximal ideals
statement: Let $k$ be a field and $S$ a finite type $k$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra] which is an integral domain. Then for every maximal ideal $\mathfrak m\subset S$ the Krull dimension [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring] of the localization $S_{\mathfrak m}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] equals the Krull dimension of $S$: $\dim(S_{\mathfrak m})=\dim(S)$. Equivalently, every maximal chain of prime ideals of $S$ has length $\dim(S)$.
